summary: Enlivex Ltd. filed a Form 6-K on May 28, 2026, providing an update on its treasury holdings of RAIN tokens. As of May 27, 2026, the company held 79.57 billion RAIN tokens valued at approximately $1.16 billion. The press release also notes the Rain Foundation's appointment of five advisory board members, a $100 million liquidity commitment, and protocol traction including 29,000 users and 100 million tokens burned. No special-situation corporate event such as an acquisition, divestiture, or capital return is announced; this is a routine portfolio update.
